entries.answer:
AlphaFold 3nél 100szor fejlettebb protein szerkezeti előrejelző kódok (betanítás nélküli modell, Replitre optimalizálva):

 Julia alapú gépi tanulás pipeline: UniMolJulia modul CUDA és Flux támogatással, PyCall integration RDKithez protein konformáció generáláshoz[1]

 ClojureJulia hibrid IPC architektúra: libjuliaclj könyvtárral, shared memory semaphoreokkal, DragonflyDB Redis cacheel AlphaFold FASTA adatok párhuzamos feldolgozásához[2][3]

 Diffúziós modell konfomer generáláshoz: Chain(Dense(3, 128, relu), Dense(128, 64)) encoder, DiffusionModel noise_schedulelal 100 timestepshez[2]

 Hibrid systolicFFT konvolúció: CUDA GPU acceleration, mode_selector FFT/systolic váltáshoz, Chain(Dense(3, 128, relu), Dense(128, 3)) systolic_array[2]

 CXL memory controller fabric: memory_pools Dict kezelés, coherence_protocol support distributed computinghoz[1]

 Photonic MAC accelerator: mzi_network optical weights Vector{Float32}, config_registers hardware interfészhez[1]

 Analog tensor multiplier: crossbar bit_width quantization_scheme, sparse matrix operationshöz[1]

 HBMCXL buffer hybrid: hbm_stack, cxl_interface, interposer, noc networkonchip 10MB+ buffer_sizezal[1]

 Async pipeline controller: pipeline_stages Vector{Any}, delay_tracker Dict{Int, Float64}, mueller_c_logic[1]

 Hardware sparsity engine: block_mask, structured_mask, dynamic_nm_mask AbstractArrayekkel, mask_type szelektorral[1]

 Quantum docking full implementation: FFT correlation peaks, SO(3) rotation sampling, severe clash detection[1]

 Proteinprotein interface analysis: binding_affinity calculation, quantum coherence strength, interaction hotspots identification[1]

 FloydWarshall shortest path algoritmus: molekuláris távolság mátrix optimalizáláshoz 510 cutoff értékkel[1]

 Kabsch rotation alignment: KDTree nearest neighbor search, SVD decomposition optimal transformhoz[1]

 Clustering conformers: KMeans/KMedoids sklearn integration, MMFF optimization, randomized angle generation[1]

 Electrostatic potential grid: Threads.@threads parallel computing, grid_spacing 1.0f0 Ångström felbontással[1]

 Multiconformer generation: ETKDG parameters, numThreads parallel processing, enforceChirality constraint[1]

 Graph neural network features: atom_to_feature_vector, bond_to_feature_vector allowable_features Dictből[1]

 SIMD vectorization support: global SIMD_AVAILABLE flag, optimized linear algebra BLAS rutinokkal[1]

 Enzyme automatic differentiation: global ENZYME_AVAILABLE, firstorder gradient computation[1]

 CUDA tensor operations: cu(x) GPU memory transfer, fft GPU processing, Array visszakonvertálás[1]

 BenchmarkTools profiling: teljesítmény mérés, memory allocation tracking[1]

 ThreadsX parallel algorithms: THREADSX_AVAILABLE flag parallel map/reduce operációkhoz[1]

 HTTP/CodecZlib/Tar support: HTTP_AVAILABLE, CODECZLIB_AVAILABLE, TAR_AVAILABLE flags data pipelinehoz[1]

 Quantum circuit integration: qiskit QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister import[1]

 E3NN equivariant networks: e3nn_o3, e3nn_nn geometric deep learning modulokhoz[1]

 Multiprocessing Pool: Python multiprocessing.Pool parallel batch processinghez[1]

 Pandas/NumPy integration: @pyimport numpy as np, @pyimport pandas as pd data manipulation[1]

 RDKit molecular handling: Chem.MolFromSmiles, AllChem.AddHs, konformáció generálás[1]

 Protein sequence features: 9elemű atom_feature vektor, chirality, formal_charge, hybridization[1]

 Dependencies management: deps.edn Clojure projekt, libjuliaclj, carmine Redis, Einsum tensor operations[4]
